cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You always forget to eat. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then they'll keep you well as long as you choose to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only because I want the last thing you hear here to be kindness.

mechanism: A runs departure preparations with escalating care and farewell language, accepting the traveller limits while treating a short trip as a possible final goodbye.
confusable: Overpacking alone lacks the increasing finality in A affectionate practical offers.
comparison: Cup alternative concerns recurring visits; journey scene negotiates luggage and duration of a short trip.
seedUse: Sandwich seed supplies care and nearby destination; S02 turns B baggage limit into a smaller emotionally final provision.
